10:00 AM • Opens Feeding Window

Recipe 1: Dhaba Soya Keema Bhurji, Phulka & Iced Mint-Jeera Shikanji

383.5 kcal 32.4g Protein 6.2g Fat 49.9g Carbs
Exact Ingredients (Digital Scale):
  • • Soya Chunks (dry raw weight) 50g (yields ~150g minced)
  • • Whole Wheat Atta / Jowar (1 large phulka) 40g dry flour
  • • Cold-Pressed Mustard or Olive Oil 5g (1 metric tsp)
  • • Finely diced Red Onions & Tomatoes 60g onion + 50g tomato
  • • Ginger & Garlic (crushed) + Green Chili 10g
  • • Iced Shikanji: Lemon, roasted jeera, black salt, mint 300ml chilled water
Method:
  1. Boil 50g soya chunks 5 mins with salt and garlic. Shock cold, squeeze thoroughly with fists, and pulse in blender for 2 seconds into a scrambled keema texture.
  2. Heat 5g oil. Crackle 1/4 tsp jeera, sauté ginger, garlic, chili, and diced onions for 4 mins until sweet and golden.
  3. Add chopped tomatoes, haldi, Kashmiri chili, coriander powder, and 2 tbsp water. Simmer 3 mins into a glossy paste.
  4. Toss the soya keema on high flame for 3 mins. Finish with kasuri methi, garam masala, and lemon juice.
  5. Knead 40g atta with warm water and cook a puffed phulka. Muddle lemon juice, black salt, roasted jeera, and mint leaves with 300ml chilled water for refreshing Shikanji!
1:00 PM • Peak Energy

Recipe 2: Velvety Thick Dal (Mustard Oil Sizzle), Basmati & Big Kachumber

482.4 kcal 22.2g Protein 6.6g Fat 83.2g Carbs
Exact Ingredients (Digital Scale):
  • • Yellow Moong + Red Masoor Dal (dry raw) 70g
  • • Basmati Rice (dry raw weight) 45g (yields ~125g cooked)
  • • Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil (Tadka) 5g (1 metric tsp)
  • • Sliced Garlic chips & Whole Red Chili 3 cloves + 1 chili
  • • Hing (Asafoetida) & Degi Mirch Generous pinch each
  • • Big Kachumber Salad (cucumber, tomato, radish) 150g with lemon & chaat masala
Method:
  1. Pressure cook 70g dal in 2.5 cups water with haldi, salt, and garlic for 3 whistles. Whisk for 30 seconds into a velvety thick stew.
  2. Heat 5g mustard oil in a small tadka pan. Add cumin seeds, hing, and sliced garlic chips. Fry until nutty golden brown. Add whole red chili.
  3. Turn off flame, add 1/4 tsp degi mirch, pour sizzling into the dal, and cover with lid for 2 minutes to trap the rustic smoky aroma!
  4. Steam 45g basmati rice in 90ml water. Toss the big salad with lemon and chaat masala. Serve hot!
3:45 – 4:00 PM • Pre-Workout Fuel (60 mins before Gym)

Recipe 3: Crispy Veggie Besan Chilla + Chilled Peanut Butter Cinnamon Shake

497.2 kcal 24.7g Protein 23.1g Fat 48.5g Carbs
Exact Ingredients (Digital Scale):
  • • Besan (Bengal Gram Flour, dry raw) 50g
  • • Natural Peanut Butter 16g (1 level standard tablespoon)
  • • Toned Cow's Milk (cold) 250ml
  • • Cold-Pressed Oil (for tawa) 4g
  • • Diced Onion, Capsicum, Tomato, Cilantro 100g
  • • Ground Cinnamon & Cardamom (for shake) Generous dash
Method:
  1. Chilla: Mix 50g besan, ajwain, turmeric, cumin, salt, and all diced vegetables with 80ml water. Cook on hot tawa using 4g oil until deeply golden and crisp on both sides.
  2. PB Shake: In a shaker or blender, combine 250ml cold milk, 1 tbsp (16g) peanut butter, and a dash of cinnamon. Shake or blend for 20 seconds into a thick, frothy, delicious peanut butter shake!
  3. Enjoy hot crispy chilla with your chilled shake at 3:45 PM. Explosive energy for your 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM workout!
7:05 – 8:00 PM • Post-Gym & Window-Closing Feast

Recipe 4: Post-Workout Whey (25g P) + Soya Curry, Roti & Haldi Milk

639.3 kcal 61.3g Protein 18.2g Fat 59.1g Carbs
Exact Ingredients (Digital Scale):
  • • Whey Protein (1 scoop in chilled water at 7:05 PM) 32g powder (25g Protein)
  • • Soya Chunks (dry raw weight) 40g (yields ~120g curried)
  • • Whole Wheat / Jowar Flour (1 roti) 35g
  • • Toned Cow's Milk (3% fat) 250ml warm
  • • Raw Almonds (soaked & peeled) 8g (~5-6 whole nuts)
  • • Cold-Pressed Oil (for curry) 4g
Method:
  1. 7:05 PM (Post-Gym): Shake 32g whey powder into 250ml chilled water and drink immediately.
  2. 7:45 PM (Dinner): Cook 40g boiled squeezed soya chunks in onion-tomato gravy with whole spices and kasuri methi. Enjoy with 1 puffed roti and fresh salad.
  3. 8:00 PM Golden Milk: Warm 250ml milk with haldi, crushed cardamom, cinnamon, and black pepper. Drink warm with your peeled soaked almonds to close your window at 8:00 PM sharp!
